title: Taser Stops Man From Attacking His Own Dog
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Vancouver, Washington — On May 14, 2025, Vancouver Police Officers located a male in the Meadow Homes neighborhood who had multiple warrants. As officers approached, he fled — carrying his dog across multiple lanes of traffic. His dog was extremely aggressive, and as officers attempted to take him into custody, the dog lunged and snarled at the officers. The suspect refused to comply, pulled out a knife, and attempted to stab his dog. Before he could stab the dog, an officer used his taser, causing the man to drop the knife. Eventually, he was allowed to place his dog into a patrol car. He was then taken into custody and booked into jail for his outstanding warrant, resisting arrest, obstructing a law enforcement officer and animal cruelty. Animal Control officers took custody of the dog.
